- **iPhone remote through AltStore.** Add
  `https://sandoramix.github.io/slop-remote-relay/altstore.json` as a source in
  AltStore or SideStore and install Relay with your own Apple ID — no paid
  developer account needed. Updates show up there with every release.
- **iOS build fixed**: it now builds with Xcode 26, as Expo SDK 57 requires.
- Release notes are now generated automatically from the commit history.
